criteria.clef: Is the collar open, rather than buttoned to the neck?
criteria.suggestion: The collar reads formal; try it open.

criteria.clef: Is the garment a relaxed shirt, rather than a stiff suit or a loud pattern?
criteria.suggestion: The garment reads stiff or loud; try a plain relaxed shirt.

criteria.clef: Is the hair off the eyes?
criteria.suggestion: The hair crosses the eyes; try it tied back.

criteria.clef: Is facial hair either absent or a short even shape, not a patchy outline?
criteria.suggestion: The beard outline is patchy; try a short even shape.

criteria.clef: Is the lip either bare or one even colour, not a smeared edge?
criteria.suggestion: The lip colour is smeared; try one even nude.

criteria.clef: Is the expression engaged, with the mouth relaxed, rather than a flat stare?
criteria.suggestion: The expression reads flat; try a closed-mouth smile.

criteria.clef: Are both eyes visible in even light, rather than a flat grey wash or a hard shadow on one side?
criteria.suggestion: The face is lit flat; move toward a window. No fix here can relight the photo.

biggest_issue.question: Which missed part of this dress code is the biggest issue?

fixes.changes: Replaces the garment with an open-collar shirt.
fixes.note: The only garment_category value in the public request example is full_body. The file spec also talks about upper-body and lower-body regions, and invalid_parameter covers a bad category, but the enum is not listed. Do not send a guessed category.

fixes.note: Template id comes from GET /s2s/v2.1/task/template/hair-transfer when T0.5 lists templates. No id is invented here. hair-type-detection needs three views, so it is not used on the one selfie.
Template id comes from GET /s2s/v2.0/task/template/beard-style. The public feature page names styles such as Shaved; those names are not template ids.

fixes.changes: Paints the lip one even nude.
fixes.note: Use category lip_color and one palette. Do not set morphology fullness or any lip shape that changes the lip outline. Do not use skin_smooth.
The documented style name is closed_mouth_smile. The overview does not print the JSON field that carries it. Grouped with face and skin tools on the MCP page, not with Creators.
